speaker_unreachable.title: Edifier {name} has not been reachable for a day
speaker_unreachable.description:
Home Assistant has not been able to reach {name} for 24 hours.

Check that the speaker is powered on and within range of a connectable Bluetooth adapter, then press **Force connect** on the speaker's device page. If the speaker was re-paired, reset or moved since it was added, it may be advertising a different Bluetooth address and needs to be added again.

This issue withdraws itself as soon as the speaker answers.
